title: Same quality every batch, honest labels, NAFDAC basics
course_title: Detergent and Cleaning Products Production: Liquid Soap, Hand Wash and Safe Cleaning

say: Same quality every batch, honest labels, and NAFDAC basics.
This is the video for module three of Detergent and Cleaning Products Production.

A product that is good one week and watery the next will lose customers. So test every batch against a specification, a short list of measurements it must meet. First, pH, read at the time printed on the strip pack.

panel.heading: Five tests for every batch
items: Cleaning: grease test on oily plates
Stability: sealed sample for a week

say: Second, thickness, with the same flow test every time.

panel.heading: Five tests for every batch
items: Cleaning: grease test on oily plates
Stability: sealed sample for a week

say: Third, look at a sample in a clear bottle against light, and smell it.

panel.heading: Five tests for every batch
items: Cleaning: grease test on oily plates
Stability: sealed sample for a week

say: Fourth, the grease test on oily plates. Foam is not a quality test.

panel.heading: Five tests for every batch
items: Cleaning: grease test on oily plates
Stability: sealed sample for a week

say: Fifth, stability. Keep a sealed, labelled sample from every batch, and watch it for at least a week. If a customer complains, you can check that same batch.

say: For example, Ifeoma in Onitsha looks at four good test batches. Her pH readings were 7, 7, 7 and 8. So she writes pH 7 to 8.

panel.heading: Ifeoma writes her specification
items: Adds salt solution in small portions

say: Her flow times were between 22 and 25 seconds, so she writes 20 to 26 seconds. She adds clear green, no lumps, passes the grease test, and no separation after 7 days.

panel.heading: Ifeoma writes her specification
items: Adds salt solution in small portions

say: Her fifth batch reads pH 7, but flows in 14 seconds. Too thin. Outside her range.

panel.heading: Ifeoma writes her specification
items: Adds salt solution in small portions

say: She adds salt solution in small portions, testing after each.

panel.heading: Ifeoma writes her specification
items: Adds salt solution in small portions
panel.rule: Fix one thing at a time, then retest and record

say: At 21 seconds it is back in range, and she records the change. She caught a thin batch before it reached a customer.

say: Sell a batch only when it meets every line of your specification.

cards.d: Only when the batch meets every line of your specification.
When the fix is safe and simple, like pH or thickness. Then test again fully.
Mould, bad smell, unknown contamination, or a cause you cannot find.

say: Rework it when the fix is safe and simple, such as adjusting pH or thickness. Then run every test again. A batch that stings hands is never sold.

say: Discard it when there is mould, a bad smell, or a problem you cannot explain. Never sell a doubtful batch cheaply. A bad product still carries your name.

say: Your label tells the buyer what the product is, how to use it safely, and who made it. Only claim what you can prove. Cuts grease, works in hard water, or near neutral pH if you tested it.

panel.heading: What you can and cannot say
left: Cuts grease on pots and plates

say: Do not say kills 99.9% of germs, or antibacterial. That is a disinfectant claim. And do not say chemical free. Everything is made of chemicals.

panel.heading: What you can and cannot say
left: Cuts grease on pots and plates

say: Put the product name, your brand and phone number, the net contents and main ingredients, and clear directions.
Add warnings. Keep out of reach of children. Rinse eyes with plenty of water. If swallowed, do not induce vomiting. Do not mix with bleach. Do not transfer into drink bottles.
Add the batch number, production date and a best-before date your samples prove. And never print a NAFDAC number you have not been given.

NAFDAC regulates detergents in Nigeria. Its micro-scale scheme lists laundry detergents and soaps. Micro scale means not more than nine employees and not more than five products. First, get a stable formula and good records.

say: Officers inspect your site and review a sample. Be careful of anyone offering to get you a number in a few days. A fake number can lead to seizure of goods and prosecution.

panel.rule: Pay only through official NAFDAC channels

say: Give every batch a number and a record. For example, when a school bursar in Abuja says two kegs stung the cleaners' hands, Amaka reads batch LS-2610-04. It was bottled at pH 6. She replaces the kegs free and adds a signed final pH check.

Store acids and alkalis apart, locked and off the floor. Never pour concentrated chemicals into drains or near wells. Never give away chemical containers for water or food. And never water down your product secretly.

panel.heading: Responsible production
items: Acids and alkalis on separate shelves
Never reuse chemical containers for food

say: Your practice: run the five tests and write your specification, draft an honest label, make a dated NAFDAC readiness checklist, and set up your batch record page.
